articles.title: WoW: Forever Just Got Another Major Racial Ability Shakeup Before Launch
articles.summary: World of Warcraft: Forever's release is just around the corner, but developer Blizzard is making one final pass at the game's racial abilities before launch in response to beta feedback.
body: In a forum post, WoW community manager Kaivax posted a list of significant changes to many of each race's unique abilities that players expressed concerns about during Forever's beta. Those changes include tweaks to tauren, humans, orcs, dwarves, and Skyborne elves.

"In taking a final pass on these, we've prioritized racial identity, which means that some races will naturally be slightly more effective than others at certain combat roles," Blizzard said. "In some places where we had replaced role or class-focused racials with generic ones, we're rolling those changes back."

The exception to that mindset is weapon-specialization abilities, Blizzard said, which existed for humans and orcs both in WoW Classic and early on in Forever's beta and made each race more effective with specific types of weapons.

"While those have a strong fantasy component to them, it is not healthy in the long run for future raid and dungeon loot tables to be evaluated through the lens of 'required' weapon types," Blizzard said. "At the same time, we're doing a tuning pass on some of the remaining passive bonuses to help ensure that they aren't skewing outcomes in a way that limits player preferences."
points: World of Warcraft: Forever's release is just around the corner, but developer Blizzard is making one final pass at the game's racial abilities before launch in response to beta feedback.

articles.title: Want To Smell Like a Werfwulf? This Perfume Has You Covered
articles.summary: Nothing says date night like the smell of "the heat of flesh that was once human." Robert Eggers' Werwulf hits movie theaters at Christmas, but you can pre-order an official perfume set based on the movie right now.
body: Designed to represent each stage of a werewolf transformation, the descriptions of each of the scents are a wild ride.
The set is limited edition, $55, and won't ship until at least November 6, but at least that's in time for Grandma's Christmas present. You can also grab each perfume individually for $125.

It's not the first movie collaboration Heretic has done. Nosferatu Eau de Macabre used notes of "wilting lilacs, velvety vegan ambergris and strikes of lightning" while one for the The Bride promised "Jasmine and rose stitched together as flesh. Cedarwood as bone. Frankincense as breath or spirit." The company is perhaps most notorious for creating the viral “This Smells Like My Vagina” candle with Gwyneth Paltrow in 2020.

She loves horror, horror movies, horror games, Red Dead Redemption 2, and her Love and Deepspace boyfriends.

articles.title: Diablo 4’s War Plans Are Getting A Huge Upgrade In Season 16
articles.summary: Diablo 4's War Plans system is getting a major upgrade in Season 16, giving players even more control over their endgame activities and rewards. Developer Blizzard introduced War Plans earlier this year as part of the game's second (and last) expansion, Lord of Hatred.
body: It was a welcome addition, but unfortunately only gave players minimal control over what activities would appear as part of their plans. Players could also only reroll their War Plans a limited number of times, meaning if you didn't like a particular activity, oftentimes you were stuck having to do it.

All of that looks to be changing in Season 16 with the addition of a new meta-progression system called War Plans Tactics. By completing War Plan activities, players will be able to invest points into the tactics tree to make it so certain activities are more likely to appear and specific types of rewards will drop. How players reroll their War Plans is also changing, with a new currency called Marks of Wisdom that will cap at 20 and should let players reroll their plans more often.

"Earn points from completing War Plans activities, then invest these points into nodes to increase the chance of preferred activities or rewards appearing," Blizzard said. "This allows you to tailor your War Plans more closely with both your goals and playstyle."
points: Diablo 4's War Plans system is getting a major upgrade in Season 16, giving players even more control over their endgame activities and rewards.

articles.title: Toastie Might Be the Weirdest iPhone Duo Game So Far
articles.summary: The first batch of iPhone Duos are out in the wild, and a bunch of app developers are finding ways to make the most of its foldable design. Perhaps the weirdest so far is Toastie, a game that essentially turns your $2,000 device into a grilled cheese maker.
body: It costs $3, less than an actual grilled cheese, and for that you get "10 orders, 3 loaves, and 14 things to put between them." Your crispy masterpiece then gets a star rating for the recipe, plating, toasting, and preparation time. You can also play on iPhone and iPad without the cute close mechanic if you're more interested in browning wheat-based products than you are fooling around with a hinge.
The game is the work of Tom Szykulski and Cyprian Brytan, and they say development took place "over more evenings than either of them planned."

articles.title: Hunger Games Director Hopes You Aren't Too Distracted With GTA 6 to See Sunrise on the Reaping
articles.summary: Francis Lawrence, director of Netflix’s BioShock movie, opened up to IGN about his favorite video games of all time, and we have to admit that he knows ball. You might know Lawrence from his work on the Hunger Games films.
body: With a slew of blockbuster adaptations under his belt, Lawrence is now helming the live-action BioShock movie at Netflix — a project that's nearly 20 years in the making. Given he’s a self-professed fan of the series, we had to ask about his favorite games of all time.

"Well, the big ones for me were Metal Gear Solid, BioShock, and Call of Duty, " he answered. "I'd say the original GTA. I don't think I played beyond the original GTA, but the original one was pretty wild when that came out, the sort of technology of it. But I think those were all kind of my favorites."

When we brought up the imminent release of GTA 6 — arguably the most technologically advanced game in the franchise and one of the most highly anticipated pop culture launches of all time — Lawrence bemoaned how close the game's release is to Sunrise on the Reaping.
"Unfortunately, I think it comes out right around the same time our movie does. Hopefully, people find time for both. Play GTA, go see our movie, play more GTA," he joked.

articles.title: Why There Won’t Be A Helldivers 3 Anytime Soon, If Ever
articles.summary: Helldivers 2 has been a huge hit for developer Arrowhead and publisher Sony, but don't expect a third game in the series anytime soon. Arrowhead's chief creative officer, Johan Pilestedt, told Rock Paper Shotgun that a sequel would reset "everything" and force the player to "start over." He doesn't…
body: "Some studios can treat players like a short-term cash grab," Pilestedt said. "We see players as the actual engine of the game: they're the ones bringing in friends, making memes, and keeping the game alive. When you have an active community doing that, you don’t need a sequel."

He went on to say that the video game industry today is "panicking" because "the old live-service tricks don't work anymore," and that would also apply to a hypothetical Helldivers 3. If Arrowhead were to make a sequel, it would need to be highly differentiated, he said.

"The biggest competitor to a Helldivers 3 would be Helldivers 2. It only makes sense to make a distinct sequel if it’s so different that both games can exist side by side. For now, making Helldivers 2 better every day makes way more sense than throwing away its momentum," he said.
Pilestedt added that 95% of the studio is working on Helldivers 2 right now, with only a small team assigned to work on whatever the team is making next.

articles.title: Mass Effect's Longshot #SaveMassEffect Campaign Actually Has a Chance
articles.summary: On Oct. 21, EA officially announced the closure of legendary RPG maker BioWare after 30 years of operation. With the shutdown, the next Mass Effect game is now trapped in EA IP purgatory.
body: Mass Effect has had a tumultuous decade. In the early 2010s, the original trilogy earned its place as one of the best RPG space operas of all time, thanks to its well-realized sci-fi world, fascinating cast of characters, and emphasis on player choice. Its 2017 spinoff, Mass Effect: Andromeda, was more divisive; players loved the action, but didn’t click with the narrative or characters like they did with the original game. EA put Mass Effect on ice soon after.

In 2020, BioWare revealed a new Mass Effect game was in the works, and teased it intermittently over the following years. Some early promotional materials suggested it would serve as connective tissue between Andromeda and the original trilogy. Shortly after BioWare’s closure, a trailer for the next Mass Effect project, called Mass Effect: Universe, leaked online, teasing a radical departure for the series. Set 600 years after the events of the main trilogy, several people familiar with production likened it to “James Bond meets John Wick in space.” For fans of the series, seeing Mass Effect: Universe footage make the rounds only made its cancellation sting even more.
points: 21, EA officially announced the closure of legendary RPG maker BioWare after 30 years of operation.
With the shutdown, the next Mass Effect game is now trapped in EA IP purgatory.

articles.title: Stardew Valley-inspired RPG Gets Shock Last-Minute Delay
articles.summary: Emberville, a dark fantasy RPG blending Stardew Valley -style farming with action-heavy dungeon crawling and an all-star voice cast, has delayed its launch just one day before its scheduled release.
body: Developer Cygnus Cross announced on Monday that Emberville will now launch into Early Access on Jan. 7, 2027, pushing back its planned Oct. 27 debut by more than two months. The team said it needs additional time to incorporate player feedback from the game's recent Steam Next Fest demo and deliver a more polished experience.

“We know this is very short notice, with launch just a day away,” the developer wrote in a letter to players. “After extensive discussions within the team, we have made the difficult decision to postpone Emberville ’s Early Access release.”

According to Cygnus Cross, feedback from the demo prompted the team to plan several improvements, but some require more extensive changes than could be completed before launch. The developer specifically cited bow combat as an area that needs additional work.
“Reworking bow combat, for example, would take more time than we had prior to our Early Access release, even though the team is working around the clock,” the letter continued.
points: Emberville, a dark fantasy RPG blending Stardew Valley -style farming with action-heavy dungeon crawling and an all-star voice cast, has delayed its launch just one day before its scheduled release.

articles.title: Cyberpunk 2077 Hits Its Biggest Steam Player Peak Since Phantom Liberty, And You Can Guess Why
articles.summary: Almost six years after launch, Cyberpunk 2077 still has a healthy player base, especially with a new anime spin-off driving people to the Night City source material. The second season of Edgerunners launched last week alongside a beefy update for Cyberpunk 2077, and unsurprisingly, PC player…
body: At the time of writing, Cyberpunk 2077 player numbers had surged to 187,215 players on PC via Steam alone. That's the biggest peak since October 2023, when the game received the substantial Update 2.0 and the Phantom Liberty expansion. This new tick in players is likely being experienced on other PC platforms where the game is available (like GOG and the Epic Games Store), as well as on multiple consoles like PS5, Xbox Series X|S, and Switch 2.

With a new update that adds dual-wielding, new cosmetics, customizable cyberware fashion, even more digital tourism, and a new story mission linked to Edgerunners, it's no wonder that player numbers are climbing again. You also can't discount Edgerunners' impact, as the Netflix anime series is likely driving an influx of new players.

The first season of Edgerunners is credited with playing a major role in Cyberpunk 2077's revival after its infamous December 2020 launch, and Edgerunners Season 2 probably makes a good case for returning to the game. CD Projekt Red has also discounted Cyberpunk 2077: Ultimate Edition by 70% on Steam, so the entry price is pretty cheap right now.
points: Almost six years after launch, Cyberpunk 2077 still has a healthy player base, especially with a new anime spin-off driving people to the Night City source material.

articles.title: Mass Effect fans ramp up efforts to save BioWare's RPG series with a Times Square billboard and plans for more ads outside The Game Awards
articles.summary: Fans continue to rally around the 'Save Mass Effect ' movement, this time with a billboard at Times Square and more initiatives planned throughout the rest of the year.
body: Last week, publisher EA shut down BioWare and cancelled the next Mass Effect game. In the days since, an increasingly loud community-organised campaign has attempted to make Electronic Arts reverse course and ensure that the beloved sci-fi universe can journey forward in some form.

The We Are Mass Effect community group and content creator Kala Elizabeth are now collaborating on a number of initiatives, including a billboard at New York City's Times Square that points people toward the growing online "SaveMassEffect" hashtag. Text that reads "Kellah Si'yah" is sprawled across the ad - referencing the in-game ship that ferried different races to settle the Andromeda system.

"Apart from the Times Square billboard, we also have several other initiatives in the works. An advertising truck near EA's headquarters in Redwood City and in Edmonton, a mobile billboard for N7 Day, and another one in LA for The Game Awards. All of them will carry a message in support of #SaveMassEffect," one of the group's organisers, Mer Mora, told me via email.
points: Fans continue to rally around the 'Save Mass Effect ' movement, this time with a billboard at Times Square and more initiatives planned throughout the rest of the year.

articles.title: GTA 6's Rumored Lucia Actor Breaks Silence With Rare Live Appearance
articles.summary: Rockstar Games has yet to officially reveal the cast behind Grand Theft Auto 6 yet, but fans are pretty sure they've figured it a few of the game's lead roles already.
body: Those rumors do not involve GTA 6 in any way, but the lack of acknowledgment on Perez's part is also exactly what makes her sudden social media appearance so notable. Perez framed the 11-minute live session as a chance for people to get to know her better. She answered some questions live, and explained why she's been so scarce on the internet. As she tells it, she's an intense introvert who can become anti-social for a week after a short but sustained interaction with someone else. While it was framed as a joke, the undercurrent — that she's a very private person — was earnest.
"I'm not a fan of social media, but for the work that I do, unfortunately, we need it," Perez said.
"I also don't feel like I'm photogenic, I don't like to show my face," Perez later added while explaining why she doesn't post more pictures or videos about her work.
Whatever the case, Perez spent the start of the livestream pushing back against what she claims is a persistent assumption about her.
points: Rockstar Games has yet to officially reveal the cast behind Grand Theft Auto 6 yet, but fans are pretty sure they've figured it a few of the game's lead roles already.

articles.title: Amid sweeping layoffs at Xbox and massive AI investments, Microsoft introduces a "Voluntary Exit Offer" to 60,000 workers
articles.summary: Xbox isn't the only Microsoft division looking to massively reduce worker headcounts. In fact, Microsoft has just announced a "Voluntary Exit Offer" that will essentially pay staff to move in front of any potential layoffs and voluntarily leave their jobs.
body: Microsoft CPO Amy Coleman announced the plan earlier today. "This offer gives eligible employees who may be considering a future outside the company a new choice to make that transition now with support. It also gives participating organizations another way to adapt their workforce to changing needs," Colemon wrote in a memo sent to staff.

The voluntary buyout is only available to Microsoft employees "at level 70 and below" in Canada, India, the United Kingdom and the United States. Some corners of the company have opted out of the offer - it's currently unclear if Xbox or any of the studios under its umbrella are participating in the initiative.

"This is a time-limited, voluntary program that gives those who are eligible the opportunity to leave Microsoft with financial support and career planning resources. Some organizations are providing the Voluntary Exit Offer, and some are not. Participation varies based on each business’s priorities, customer commitments and workforce needs," Coleman added.
points: Xbox isn't the only Microsoft division looking to massively reduce worker headcounts.

articles.title: World of Warcraft: Forever's last-minute patch transforms its bovines into racecars capable of zooming 60% faster than everyone else
articles.summary: The World of Warcraft: Forever min-maxers have been arguing about the pros and cons of each playable race since the throwback MMO was announced. It isn't enough to just pick whoever looks cool for some people.
body: Admittedly, WoW: Forever will be stuck in an era where unique racial abilities and traits mattered a lot more than they do in the modern version of the MMO. Some of them directly synergize with certain classes and others just make your life a lot easier for what will be a long journey. This is probably why Blizzard is still tweaking them a week from launch day.

Despite trying to balance them evenly before, Blizzard is doubling down on some racials having clear advantages for certain classes over others. You can see how this looks in today's patch notes, but you won't be able to test anything out until the WoW: Forever goes live next week.

Most of the changes fit that ethos: orcs, for example, won't have an increased critical strike chance but increased pet damage for warlocks and hunters. The skyborne, the new blue elves, had their absurdly powerful Read Leyline ability that makes them regenerate health and mana faster than anyone else cut in half. It's still good, but not broken good.
And then there are the tauren, the bipedal bovines who have been in WoW since the beginning, who have apparently discovered nitrous oxide.
points: The World of Warcraft: Forever min-maxers have been arguing about the pros and cons of each playable race since the throwback MMO was announced.

videos.summary: Check out the trailer for the HumanitZ 1.1 Major Update. HumanitZ is an open-world zombie survival game where you scavenge, craft, build, and fight off the hordes, solo or with friends. The new update brings recruitable survivors, a new Headshot-Only Mode, and the ability to hunt yourself down.
points: Check out the trailer for the HumanitZ 1.1 Major Update.
HumanitZ is an open-world zombie survival game where you scavenge, craft, build, and fight off the hordes, solo or with friends.
The new update brings recruitable survivors, a new Headshot-Only Mode, and the ability to hunt yourself down.
If you die after being bitten by a zeek, you'll turn into one!
